tools.name: find_market_by_zip
tools.description: Submit a 5-digit US ZIP code to locate the corresponding regional market depot and navigate to its local container pricing and inventory page.

tools.name: get_delivery_guidelines
tools.description: Read container delivery guidelines, site preparation checklist, space requirements, and clearance information.

tools.name: list_container_types
tools.description: List available shipping container types, standard sizes, and links to their product specification guides.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List nationwide service markets and depot locations with their state, city, and market page URLs, with optional filtering by state.

state.description: Optional state name to filter locations (e.g. 'Texas', 'California', 'Arizona')

tools.name: open_market_page
tools.description: Navigate to a local market pricing page for a selected city or state.

market_url.description: The URL or path of the market page (e.g. /shipping-containers-for-sale/texas/dallas)

tools.name: open_product_guide
tools.description: Navigate to a container specification and product guide page.

product_guide_url.description: The URL or path of the container product guide (e.g. /buy-20ft-shipping-containers)
